name: Arjuna
source: Archer's True Name is Arjuna, the great hero of Hindu Mythology from the ancient Indian epic poem, "Mahabharata", and the rival of Karna. The Mahabharata is a dazzling story that gathers all heroes from India, but it is no exaggeration to say that Arjuna is an existence placed at the center of it all, the one who is in the position of the protagonist.
